image_description: A close-up, cropped view of two vertical traffic light units. The unit on the left shows a green light at the bottom and dark lenses above. The unit on the right shows an illuminated amber/yellow light at the top and a red light below it. The image has significant white 'snow' or blur artifacts obscuring the edges and background, suggesting a generation error or severe weather simulation gone wrong.
